items.title: S.A.M.S.
items.description: Comprehensive ERP and Point of Sale (POS) IT system to manage inventory, cashier, purchases, and sales in real time. Developed under the Iconix agile methodology, it supports up to 8 simultaneous cash registers and implements SHA-256 encryption to protect employee and supplier information.

items.title: MediDietas
items.description: Comprehensive platform connecting patients with nutritionists for diet and calorie tracking. Microservices architecture with a REST API and gRPC server in Node.js, native Android mobile client, and JavaFX desktop client. Deployment managed with Docker containers and quality assured via automated endpoint testing with Jest and Supertest.

items.title: TicketPlus
items.description: Scalable web platform for selling and managing electronic tickets (e-tickets). Developed under the IWEB methodology for an iterative cycle, it features a robust architecture divided into frontend, middleware (REST API), and backend with MySQL. Focused on high concurrency and strict authentication flows.

items.title: Hangman.NET
items.description: Real-time multiplayer game of the classic hangman. Implementation of a robust Client-Server architecture using Windows Communication Foundation (WCF) and real-time communication via TCP Sockets, with database mapping through LINQ to SQL.
